verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents payment mandates explicitly covering Sweeping VRPs, Wave 1 VRPs, and Direct Debits, with dedicated docs on creating a mandate and executing recurring payments on an authorised mandate without further user auth. This directly matches variable recurring payments, standing consents, and recurring debit flows built on the Payments API. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs, and more detail on standing consent lifecycle management (renewal/revocation).
